hero.headline: Laro para sa tanan.
hero.tagline: Sports programs, facilities and events for every Butuanon, from barangay courts to national meets.

about.intro: The City Sports Office plans and runs the city's sports development programs, supports local athletes, and manages the use of city sports facilities.
mandate: Develop grassroots sports in every barangay
Train and send city delegations to regional and national games
Manage schedules and use of city sports facilities
Organize city-wide sports events and tournaments

services.title: Sports development
services.text: Year-round training for basketball, volleyball, athletics, swimming and more.

services.title: Athlete delegations
services.text: Selection and support of city athletes for Batang Pinoy, Palarong Pambansa and the Philippine National Games.

services.title: Barangay sports clinics
services.text: Free weekend clinics run with barangay councils and volunteer coaches.

services.title: City events
services.text: Fun runs, inter-barangay leagues and holiday tournaments.

facilities.note: To request a facility, visit the office with a letter of request at least 7 working days before your event.
